verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI runs agents on recurring cron schedules through the hub. Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session. Headless mode and full auto-approve cover unattended execution, and the native app can schedule routines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled background runs, and documentation depth on managing and monitoring scheduled agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
Run agents on cron schedules for recurring automations like daily summaries and code reviews.
Autonomous execution can modify files and run commands without further prompts.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.

Run agent sessions in any folder, schedule
routines, and manage models, plugins, and MCP servers.
